tools.name: search

Returns at most 5 providers or 10 listings from real accounts, ordered by relevance, each with its pikosabe.com link. tools.name: show_listing
tools.description: Returns one active listing by its id: title, description, price, place, owner and its pikosabe.com link. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

tools.name: show_profile
tools.description: Returns one public profile, found by user id or by name or @nickname: biography, place, rating, recent reviews, active offers and demands, and its pikosabe.com link. When several profiles match a name, returns the list of matches instead. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosab

tools.name: prepare_listing
tools.description: Stores a draft of a listing for 24 hours and returns a pikosabe.com link to it. Nothing is published by this tool: the person opens the link, signs in to Piko with their phone, reviews the prefilled form and publishes it themselves. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
